summary: Implemented and locally verified the Batch 015 deterministic visible-fact corpus, real understand_image runner, layered evidence benchmark, compare ordering, CRC-safe PNG fixtures, and long-image regression coverage. All authorized repository/package/benchmark gates pass. Completion remains PARTIAL because GitHub authentication prevented opening the required Draft PR and therefore its final CI, and no explicitly authorized hosted/local visual provider was available.
